description:
Return a short-lived signed URL for a catalogue asset zip (mesh, params, licence). Read-only. No sign-in.
The URL is already signed. Fetch it with GET. Do not send an API key or an Authorization header. It expires quickly; read expires_at. Share download_url with the user.
Units in the pack follow the catalogue: metres, Y is up. A rig, when present, names pivots of type rotate (degrees) or slide (metres).
If the publisher stored no pack, the result is { ok: false, error: "not_stored" }.

slug.description: Catalogue slug from search_assets or get_asset.

name: get_asset_pack
title: Get Catalogue Asset Pack
